text: Figure 4.19: Implementation of the InstanceRef for the mapping of elements of compos- ite application data types [constr_1185] Consistency of data types in the context of ApplicationCompos- iteElementInPortInterfaceInstanceRef ⌈The definition of attributes con- textDataPrototype and targetDataPrototype shall (via the type-prototype pat- tern) be enclosed in the context of the definition of the data type used to type root- DataPrototype at the time when the RTE is generated .⌋() In other words, it shall be possible to reach contextDataPrototype and target- DataPrototype by means of the type-prototype chain created by the definition of the data type used to type rootDataPrototype. And, as implied by the definition of the InstanceRef, the contextDataPrototypes shall enclose each other and, eventually , the targetDataPrototype.
